assets.name: Sunshack
assets.scale_status: Proposed game-art dimensions, not measured CAD. Main body width/depth exclude attached stairs, balconies and eaves; total height includes roof/tower. Placement envelope is a blockout allowance for attachments, not a gameplay clearance or building code.
assets.silhouette: Porch shack with mustard timber, coral gable roof and teal openings.
assets.roof_and_height: Gable ridge runs front to rear (+Y); front eave 2.5 m, ridge 3.3 m.
assets.opening_schedule: Front: teal door left, one window right. Right side: one window. Rear: one centered window. Left side: plain.
assets.construction_notes: Porch projects 0.8 m from front; two posts and one shallow step. Keep roof supports chunky. Broad plank seams are enough; no warped or rotten boards.
assets.view_resolution: The hero front and rear roof shapes agree. Preserve the front door/window arrangement when making palette variants.
assets.pivot: At ground level, horizontally centered on the FRONT main-wall baseline. Main body occupies X=-width/2..+width/2 and Y=0..depth; front attachments extend into negative Y.
assets.coordinates: Meters, +X right in front view, +Y into building from front facade, +Z up.
assets.variant_rules: Keep openings and overall scale consistent. Swap predefined paint regions, shutters, roof accents and optional lamps. Mirror only when balcony/stair access and roof attachments are also resolved.

assets.view_resolution: The sheet's side and rear views disagree about roof slope. Use the single X-sloping plane specified here; do not slope the roof in both directions.

assets.name: Stilt Hut
assets.scale_status: Proposed game-art dimensions, not measured CAD. Main body width/depth exclude attached stairs, balconies and eaves; total height includes roof/tower. Placement envelope is a blockout allowance for attachments, not a gameplay clearance or building code.
assets.silhouette: Cream raised timber hut with teal hip roof, coral door and a veranda.
assets.roof_and_height: Hipped roof over square body; floor 0.9 m, eave 3.5 m, roof top 4.6 m.
assets.opening_schedule: Front: centered door and two windows, one on each side. Side: one window per side. Rear: one centered window.
assets.construction_notes: Six structural stilts in a 3-by-2 plan: three columns along X at -1.7, 0, +1.7 m, and two rows along Y at 0.3 and 3.7 m. Porch can use additional local braces. Separate staircase and rail modules.
assets.view_resolution: Support counts and stair perspective vary in the sheet. Six main stilts are authoritative; keep all front-view windows. Stair rises 0.9 m and projects approximately 1.6 m.
